question: Behaviour Change Communication (BCC) goes beyond Information, Education and Communication (IEC) by addressing the underlying motivational, social, and environmental factors that sustain health behaviours, rather than focusing solely on knowledge transfer.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Incorrect. BCC does go beyond IEC. IEC focuses on knowledge transfer; BCC incorporates motivational interviewing, social support, and environmental enablers to bridge the knowledge-attitude-practice (KAP) gap.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. IEC primarily targets knowledge and awareness; BCC adds motivational, social-norm, and environmental strategies to move from knowledge to sustained behaviour change — the KAP gap.
